description: NFT Lock State Detection - Fix inaccurate lock state for pNFTs by fetching Token Record accounts on backend

userStories.title: Add Token Record PDA derivation to DAS service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Token Record PDA derivation on the backend to fetch pNFT lock state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TOKEN_METADATA_PROGRAM_ADDRESS constant to das.ts (reuse from vault-transactions.ts pattern)
Add getTokenRecordPda(mint, tokenAccount) function using getProgramDerivedAddress from @solana/kit
Add getAssociatedTokenAddress(mint, owner) helper to derive ATA for token account
Seeds for Token Record: ['metadata', programId, mint, 'token_record', tokenAccount]
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement pNFT lock state enrichment
userStories.description: As a user, I want pNFTs to show accurate lock state based on Token Record.
acceptanceCriteria: After processItem loop, collect all pNFTs (tokenStandard === 'ProgrammableNonFungible')
For each pNFT, derive Token Record PDA using getTokenRecordPda(mint, ata)
Batch fetch Token Records using rpc.getMultipleAccounts with chunks of 1000
Import decodeTokenRecord from @biblio/solana-programs and TokenState enum
Decode each account and check state: frozen = (tokenRecord.state === TokenState.Locked)
Update the asset's frozen field with the decoded value
Handle missing Token Records gracefully (account may not exist for unlocked pNFTs)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create single NFT fetch endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint to refetch a single NFT with updated lock state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /nfts/:mint route to apps/api/src/routes/nfts.ts
Use rpc.getAsset({ id: mint }) to fetch single asset from Helius DAS
Process with processItem() to get DASAsset shape
For pNFTs, fetch Token Record and enrich lock state (extract shared helper from getAssetsByOwner)
Return same DASAsset shape as bulk fetch endpoints
Return 404 if asset not found
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add refetch action to NFT store
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a store action to refetch and update a single NFT.
acceptanceCriteria: Add refetchNftAtom write atom to apps/web/src/stores/nfts.ts
Action takes mint address as parameter
Calls GET /api/nfts/:mint endpoint
Updates the NFT in nftsAtom array with fresh data
If NFT not found in local array, ignore (don't add)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Call refetch after successful unvault
userStories.description: As a user, when I unvault an NFT, it should stay removed from vault view.
acceptanceCriteria: In UnvaultDialog.tsx after successful signWithMultipleWallets, call refetchNft for each unvaulted mint
Refetch happens after removeVaultedMints call
Refetched NFT data has frozen: false, preventing re-detection as vaulted
NFT no longer reappears in vault view after unvault
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract enrichLockState helper for reuse
userStories.description: As a developer, I want lock state enrichment logic shared between bulk and single fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: Create enrichPnftLockState(rpc, assets) helper function in das.ts
Takes RPC client and array of DASAssets
Filters to pNFTs, fetches Token Records, updates frozen field in place
Use this helper in both getAssetsByOwner and single NFT endpoint
Avoids code duplication
Typecheck passes
